elements.label: Statutory & Trade Authorities
elements.description: EU AI Office & national authorities, FTC/state AGs, BIS export controls, China CAC, UK & APAC regulators
elements.GPAI Fine Powers: Commission fining powers over GPAI providers apply from 2 Aug 2026 (GPAI obligations since 2 Aug 2025)
elements.Enforcement Powers: EU: fines up to 7% of global turnover for prohibited practices (Art. 99), up to 3% for GPAI providers (Art. 101); US: ex-post enforcement, litigation, export-control sanctions; China: registration and licensing regimes; stop orders.

elements.label: Standards Setting Organisations
elements.description: ISO/IEC JTC 1/SC 42, NIST, CEN-CENELEC, IEEE
elements.Harmonization Role: Harmonised European standards (hENs) and ISO/IEC 42001 AIMS controls
elements.Variety Function: Attenuates technical variety into standardised conformity benchmarks

elements.label: AI Safety & Security Institutes
elements.description: US CAISI (formerly AISI), UK AI Security Institute, Japan AISI, frontier evaluators
elements.Red Team Role: Pre-deployment red-teaming, bio/cyber capability evaluations, systemic-risk thresholds

elements.label: Conformity & Certification Bodies
elements.description: EU notified bodies, ISO/IEC 42001 certifiers
elements.Role: EU conformity assessment where a notified body is required (Art. 43; most Annex III systems use internal control instead) and voluntary ISO/IEC 42001 certification

elements.label: AI Risk Underwriter & Insurer
elements.description: Algorithmic liability and cyber risk carriers
elements.Underwriting Gate: Requires verifiable audit trail and human oversight

elements.label: Capital Markets & Venture Underwriters
elements.description: VC syndicates, hyperscaler equity, sovereign wealth
elements.Financing Role: Funds fab capex, compute campuses, lab compute credits and long-dated power purchase agreements

elements.label: Legislatures & Executive Policy-Makers
elements.description: EU Parliament & Council, US Congress & executive, national parliaments, ministries
elements.Role: Sets objectives, statutory mandates and funding; ultimate policy closure for each regime

elements.label: Courts & Dispute Resolution
elements.description: National and EU courts, arbitration, class-action mechanisms
elements.Role: Interprets statute and adjudicates liability and redress

elements.label: Civil Society, Researchers & Media
elements.description: NGOs, journalists, academic researchers, incident databases, advocacy groups
elements.Role: Surfaces harm and holds institutions to account; the public alarm channel when formal channels are slow

elements.label: Leading-Edge Silicon & Lithography
elements.description: ASML (EUV), TSMC (foundry), Nvidia, HBM memory
elements.Cluster: 1. Upstream Silicon, Energy, Cloud, Data & Model Supply
elements.Geopolitical Exposure: Concentrated in the Taiwan Strait and the Netherlands; subject to US export controls
elements.Capex Cycle: $20B+ per fab; 3-5 year construction lead time

elements.label: Energy Grids & Power Generation
elements.description: Nuclear PPAs, substation transformers, cooling
elements.Cluster: 1. Upstream Silicon, Energy, Cloud, Data & Model Supply
elements.Physical Bottleneck: Substation transformer lead times of 3-5 years; GW-scale interconnection queues
elements.Environmental Impact: Carbon intensity, baseline grid load, cooling water consumption

elements.label: Training Compute Campuses
elements.description: Mega data centers, GW-scale cluster fabric, power substations
elements.Cluster: 1. Upstream Silicon, Energy, Cloud, Data & Model Supply

elements.label: Hyperscaler Cloud Platform
elements.description: Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, OCI
elements.Cluster: 1. Upstream Silicon, Energy, Cloud, Data & Model Supply
elements.Market Role: Vertical aggregator: compute tenancy, hosted foundation models, enterprise IAM fabric
elements.Lock In Mechanism: Data egress fees, committed-spend discounts, sovereign cloud zones
elements.Evolution Note: Commodity utility with artificial lock-in; high switching cost despite commodity stage

elements.label: Training Data & Rights Holders
elements.description: Publishers, creators, data brokers, annotation vendors, licensing collectives
elements.Cluster: 1. Upstream Silicon, Energy, Cloud, Data & Model Supply
elements.Legal Exposure: Copyright, licensing and data-protection claims against model training

elements.label: Frontier AI Labs
elements.description: Organisations that train and release frontier models
elements.Cluster: 1. Upstream Silicon, Energy, Cloud, Data & Model Supply
elements.Safety Governance: Published frontier-safety frameworks, staged release gating, external red-team access

elements.label: Frontier Foundation Model
elements.description: Globally replicated weights and inference fleets
elements.Cluster: 1. Upstream Silicon, Energy, Cloud, Data & Model Supply
elements.Compute Profile: High memory-bandwidth inference clusters; low latency

elements.label: Open-Weight Model Commons
elements.description: Commoditised weights, distilled checkpoints, local runtimes
elements.Cluster: 1. Upstream Silicon, Energy, Cloud, Data & Model Supply
elements.Regulatory Note: Partial open-source exemptions under the EU AI Act; check current text

elements.label: AI Applications
elements.description: Vertical enterprise solutions (legal, medical, finance, ops) and consumer apps
elements.Margin Exposure: Squeezed between token costs and platform absorption

elements.label: Agent Runtime
elements.description: Plan-act loop: reasoning, tool use, working and episodic state
elements.CoALA Memory: Working (context), episodic (trace history), procedural (skills, prompts); semantic memory sits in N_KNOWLEDGE_STORE

elements.label: Policy & Guardrail Kernel
elements.description: Least privilege, pre-execution authorisation, kill switch, scope limits

elements.label: Sovereign Audit Ledger
elements.description: Tamper-evident WORM state and forensic store

elements.label: Observability & Evals Engine
elements.description: Continuous evaluation, traces, cost telemetry
elements.Capabilities: LLM-as-judge, OTEL tracing, token telemetry, independent red-teaming

elements.label: Enterprise Deployer
elements.description: Legal principal and economic sponsor
elements.Liability Posture: Holds vicarious and strict legal liability

elements.label: Enterprise AI Governance Function
elements.description: AI risk committee, management-system owner, horizon scanning
elements.Role: Scans models, vendors, regulation and incidents; refines policy for the guardrail layer

elements.label: Enterprise Identity & Auth (IdP)
elements.description: OAuth, OIDC, workload IAM, ephemeral tokens
elements.Security Role: Issues scoped actor delegations to agents (A2E)

elements.label: Enterprise Semantic Knowledge Base
elements.description: Proprietary vector DBs, documents, embeddings

elements.label: Human Task Delegator & Overseer
elements.description: End user and mandatory human-in-the-loop supervisor

elements.label: Capability & Tool Gateway
elements.description: Decoupled tool broker and context provider (MCP)
elements.Security Role: Tool discovery, sandbox isolation, scope negotiation

elements.label: Target Systems & Operational APIs
elements.description: Databases, production ERP, financial rails

elements.label: Affected Individuals & Consumers
elements.description: Consumers, employees, citizens
elements.Legal Standing: Private right of action, tort plaintiff, data subject

elements.label: Adversaries & Misuse Actors
elements.description: Cybercriminals, state actors, prompt-injection attackers, malicious tool publishers
elements.Variety Role: Main source of adversarial environmental variety the control layers must absorb
